title: Preservation of the tape window
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ Boolean work tapes whose heads lie in the integer interval $[-s,s]$ and whose tape contents are blank outside that interval, where $s\in\mathbb{N}$. For any action $a$, the configuration obtained by applying $a$ still has all heads in that interval and all tape contents blank outside it if and only if, on every tape, the head is not at $-s$ while moving left and is not at $s$ while moving right.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration on a Boolean input and is in the radius-$s$ window
